toni: heads-up: bringing up aurora-lite (llama-derivative) — quant int8 asymmetric run shows consistent early-eos when prompts contain a zero-width non-joiner (U+200C). float32/float16 fine. suspect tokenizer normalizer or id shift + rotary packing interplay.

rahul: can you paste a failing exemplar? simple reproducer helps.

toni: repro: prompt `Explain: zero-width test` (note U+200C at end). outputs: 
```
fp16: "Explanation: ... end."
int8-asym: "Explanation:" <EOS> (truncated)
```
probing shows model predicts EOS token probability spike when that invisible char appears.

julia: odds are either the exporter mapped U+200C to sentinel EOS-adjacent id, or our quant packing flipped sign on rotary for low bits leading to alignment with EOS logits. did you inspect tokenizer mapping and the embedding vector for that token id?

toni: ran `tools/dump_token_info.py --char "\u200c" --model aurora-lite` -> token id 502, embedding norm 0.0012 (very small). original repo has id 501 and norm 0.98. so converter off-by-one + embed got quantized to near-zero for int8 due to asymmetric clipping during calibration.

ci-bot: run 8162230010: int8 asym smoke 50 prompts: early-eos rate 14% vs fp16 baseline 1.2%. attached /artifacts/8162230010/eos-smoke.log and calib histogram /artifacts/8162230010/calib-hist.png

rahul: two axes to fix: 1) converter bug (token id shift) — easy; 2) quant calibration (clipping / asymmetric buckets) — needs re-calibration or per-channel scale. try quick patch: remap token id in tokenizer table and rerun quant with per-channel symmetric scales (int8_sym_pc).

toni: patched tokenizer mapping locally (501 -> 502) and re-calibrated with per-channel symmetric. quick smoke: early-eos down to 2.1%, embedding norms match upstream. still small gap vs fp16 but acceptable for initial deploy.

julia: note: the embedding near-zero suggests our export zeroed that row during integerization (saw this before when using global clip thresholds). add guard to ensure embeddings below threshold aren't slammed to zero; use percentile-based clipping per-channel for embeddings.

rahul: also add a small onboarding eval: fuzz invisible unicode chars (U+200B..U+200F) and assert early-eos delta < 0.03 vs fp16. we'll add as part of tokenizer-conversion CI.

ci-bot: matrix posted: /artifacts/8162230010/matrix.csv rows: fp16, int8_asym, int8_sym_pc, int8_sym_pc+token-fix.

toni: creating ENG-ML-1130 for converter fix + ENG-ML-1131 for quant tweak. attaching reproducer and artifacts to both.

julia: i'll add unit that checks embedding norm ratio for any token mapped during conversion; fail conversion if ratio < 0.1 vs reference.

rahul: thumbs up. once PR for converter lands, let's re-run dedicated regression suite on sentinel infra. ping @eng-releases for scheduling.

ci-bot: scheduled re-run 8162233600 includes int8_sym_pc baseline.
